findings.title: v2 listUsers drops is_active filter present in legacy
findings.rationale: Legacy handler only returned active users (is_active === true). v2 returns all rows. That is an API parity regression even if the migration compiles and tests only check 200 OK.

rationale: Requires comparing old vs new behavior (context beyond happy-path reading of the new handler). Matches ReviewBench 'API parity' style issues.
